chunks: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed God has an angel whose feet are in the lowest earth — a journey of five hundred years — and his head is in the highest heaven — a journey of a thousand years — saying: 'Glory be to You! Glory be to You, wherever You are! How great are You!'
He said: Then God, Mighty and Majestic, reveals to him: 'He does not know that, the one who swears falsely by Me.'

key_terms.سُبْحَانَكَ: Tasbih — glorification of God, affirming His absolute transcendence and freedom from defect
key_terms.مَلَك: Angel — a created being of light, assigned specific cosmic roles of worship and obedience
key_terms.يَحْلِفُ بِي كَاذِباً: Swearing a false oath by God — a major sin that constitutes a disregard for God's omniscience and greatness

ai.seo_question: What does Islam say about swearing a false oath by God?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) transmits a prophetic narration in which the Prophet describes an immense angel who perpetually glorifies God, spanning the distance from the lowest earth to the highest heaven. God then reveals a sobering contrast: despite this angel's ceaseless praise and intimate knowledge of God's greatness, a person who swears a false oath by God does not truly know what that angel knows — i.e., the awe-inspiring magnitude of God. This hadith appears in the chapter on false oaths, using cosmological imagery to impress upon listeners the gravity of taking God's name in vain.

en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has an Angel whose feet are in the lowest earth of a travel distance of five hundred years, and his head is in the high sky of a travel distance of a thousand years, saying: ‘Glory be to You<sup>azwj</sup>! Glory be to You<sup>azwj</sup>, wherever You<sup>azwj</sup> were! So what is Greater than You<sup>azwj</sup>’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Revealed unto him: “He does not know that, the one who swears falsely by Me<sup>azwj</sup>”.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘Allah has an angel whose legs are on the lowest earth. The length of his leg is a distance of five hundred years’ journey and his head is in the highest sky with a length of one thousand years’ journey. He says, “O Lord, You are free of all defects, O Lord, You are free of all defects, as ever You have been and how great You are!”
He (the Messenger of Allah) then said, ‘Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, sends revelation to him saying, “One who swears falsely by My name does not know this fact.’””
